ops.name: Fill reservoir L and put it on the dock
ops.where: glovebox or hood, then the tray at the access opening

steps.step: Hand on the reservoir's lid handle (z = 258)
steps.detail: blocked: from the front: hand: Enclosed beam tube

steps.step: Reservoir L slides out on its dovetail and out through the guard door
steps.detail: free along (0, -125, 0) -> (0, -520, 0); tightest gap 0.85 mm to Metering base (6061, fluted roller over a 100 mm d

steps.step: Fill it in the glovebox (or under argon in a hood): ~80 g per 15 mm build; weigh, close, NFC tag
Slide it back on (the reverse path, checked above); the dock cam opens its shutter

ops.name: Finish a build: cool down, raise the plate, take it out, empty the overflow, return powder

steps.step: Cool the plate to < 50 C (door interlock, module_params.T_DOOR_OPEN): ~50 min for Ø50 (preheat-and-plates.md)
Vent to air through the filter; passivation per the cleaning SOP (pain-points P35)
Hand through the chamber door to the plate (plate top at z = +8 mm; hand centre 37 mm above it)
steps.detail: hand + forearm clear from the front

steps.step: Plate: turned 60 deg off its bayonet, lifted 20 mm (spigot and lugs over the 8 mm door sill), out through the door
steps.detail: free along (0, 0, 20) -> (0, -520, 20); tightest gap 2.0 mm to Heater block L75 (6061-T6, bayonet socket)

steps.step: Fingers on the overflow jar's KF-40 clamp under the floor
steps.detail: blocked: from the front: hand: Cross-flow outlet plenum under the floor, hand: Outlet plenum port; from (0.6, -0.8, 0): hand: Chamber legs, forearm: Chamber legs; from the right: forearm: Sealed cyclone + HEPA housing, forearm: Filter outlet

steps.step: KF-40 clamp opened and taken off by hand
Overflow jar: clamp off, drop 5 mm off the centring ring, out
steps.detail: (0, 0, -5) -> (0, -520, -5) blocked by Cross-flow outlet plenum under the floor (316L, flat over th after 57.0 mm; also tried (0, 0, -5) -> (0, 0, 515): Overflow port (KF-40) at 11.0 mm; (0, 0, -5) -> (520, 0, -5): Overflow-jar present sensor (inductive M at 15.0 mm; (0, 0, -5) -> (-520, 0, -5): Build module L75: spigot, flange, honed  at 33.0 mm

steps.step: Sieve (63 um) and return powder in the glovebox; log mass
Old plate out (as U4)
steps.detail: free along (0, 0, 20) -> (0, -520, 20); tightest gap 2.0 mm to Heater block L75 (6061-T6, bayonet socket)

steps.step: New plate in (reverse path); graphite foil; turned 60 deg to lock
Cool, vent; Z arm released (drops 45 mm away from the striker)
Two captive M6 screws, from under the chamber
steps.detail: 2 screws; 2 reachable with: hex key 5 mm, long arm in, hex key 5 mm, short arm in; torque driver blocked by tool: VLM tray 2450 x 864 mm, tool: Build module L75

per_screw.screw: Captive M6 panel screws on the module flange #1
per_screw.tool: hex key 5 mm, short arm in (ISO 2936 85 x 33)

per_screw.screw: Captive M6 panel screws on the module flange #2
per_screw.tool: hex key 5 mm, long arm in (ISO 2936 long 120 x 33)

steps.step: Hand on the module handle's grip block, in front of the door
steps.detail: hand + forearm clear from the front

steps.step: Module out along its swap path (drop 40, forward 170, up 18, over the guard sill)
steps.detail: swap path clear; tightest gap 0.1 mm to Chamber floor plate (6061-T6, 20 mm, bolted under the frame; floor O-ring gland, module port, slots)

steps.step: New module in (reverse path); captive screws at half torque (hot-swap.md); Z arm up; purge
Reservoir L out
steps.detail: free along (0, -125, 0) -> (0, -520, 0); tightest gap 0.85 mm to Metering base (6061, fluted roller over a 100 mm d

steps.step: Other reservoir on (reverse path); NFC read; the load cell tares
